_comment: Your decisions about commitments. `approved`: records you confirmed from social posts or elsewhere ({name, gradYear, pos, club, state, sourceKind, sourceUrl, postedAt, approvedAt, note}). `rejected`: post/record ids you dismissed. `merges`: [{from: id, into: id}] when two records are the same person. `statusOverrides`: {id: verbal|signed|enrolled|decommitted}.
